parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the backup vault. The description can be 0 to 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: EncryptType
parameters.description:
The encryption type of the source data. This parameter is valid only if you set VaultType to STANDARD or OTS\_BACKUP. Valid values:

- **HBR\_PRIVATE**: The backup vault is encrypted using the built-in encryption method of Cloud Backup.

- **KMS**: The backup vault is encrypted using a customer master key (CMK) from Key Management Service (KMS).

parameters.name: KmsKeyId
parameters.description: The ID or alias of the KMS key. This parameter is required only if you set EncryptType to KMS.

parameters.name: Replication
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create a replication vault.

parameters.name: VaultName
parameters.description: The name of the backup vault. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: VaultRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the backup vault.

parameters.name: VaultStorageClass
parameters.description:
The storage class of the backup vault.

- **STANDARD**: Standard.

- **ARCHIVE**: This value is deprecated.

- **COLD\_ARCHIVE**: This value is deprecated.

- **IA**: This value is deprecated.

parameters.name: VaultType
parameters.description:
The type of the backup vault. Valid values:

- **STANDARD**: a standard backup vault.

- **OTS\_BACKUP**: a Tablestore backup vault.

parameters.name: WormEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable backup locking.
